intervention_reason: The project does not deploy capital or intervene in markets. It forecasts cross-sectional ETF returns and evaluates a portfolio construction method offline.
claim: Predictive association only. No causal effect is estimated and no do() claim is made.

limitations: Latent market regime and flows are not fully observed.
ETF metadata may be a current snapshot, not a point-in-time variable.
The ETF universe may omit closed funds.
No live intervention exists, so performative feedback is out of scope.
Any causal language in the report is a protocol violation.
